title: CombatAesthetic priority task progress
summary: CombatAesthetic is being used as the action-combat validation project while reusable UI, gameplay, 2D, input, animation, and network concerns are separated into Yu5h1Lib / UnityExtension decisions. A new core design question is whether the game should enforce physical aesthetics: no perfect cloning and no process-free teleportation.

tasks.title: Settle shared Viewer/View scope
tasks.summary: A decision report now defines the first success target: CombatAesthetic UI_Manager/UI_Menu and Virtual-Chat-Partner MainMenu/Page should both be replaceable by one shared Viewer/View source without behavior regression.

completed_items.title: Compared UI_Manager/UI_Menu with MainMenu/Page and identified the shared Viewer/View responsibility split.
Created Documentation/plans/Priority-Decision-Report.md with the initial scope, success standard, suspected legacy fields, and decision list.

pending_items.title: User answers the Viewer/View decision list, starting with return target naming and Back handler behavior.
Choose whether Virtual-Chat-Partner Page flow or CombatAesthetic UI_Menu flow is the first migration validation target.
Do not implement Viewer/View migration until the decision list is validated.

tasks.title: Define the physical-aesthetic game core
tasks.summary: The game core should preserve physical aesthetics: objects may move extremely fast, but should not relocate without process; entities should not be treated as perfect clones because even similar-looking things have different material sources and states.

completed_items.title: Recorded the principle that CombatAesthetic should avoid process-free teleportation and perfect cloning as core rule assumptions.

pending_items.title: Decide how players are born or enter the world.
Define the boundary between very fast movement and disallowed instant relocation.
Define whether any copy, summon, duplicate, or projection is allowed, and what material/source cost it must preserve.
Decide which layer owns spawn and relocation authority for online play.

tasks.title: Map reusable systems to Yu5h1Lib packages
tasks.summary: CombatAesthetic should remain the action-combat aesthetics integration layer. Generic gameplay, 2D, UI, input, AI, animation, and network foundations need package ownership decisions before file moves.

completed_items.title: Existing package split plan records the recommended broad package boundaries.

pending_items.title: Produce a class-to-package mapping table before moving files.
Mark generic classes that should be promoted to Yu5h1Lib package candidates.
Keep package moves deferred until dependency direction is clear.

tasks.title: Clarify combat refactor boundaries
tasks.summary: The first combat refactor decisions should clarify AttributeBehaviour, HostData2D command-source responsibilities, CharacterController2D slimming, and AnimatorCharacterController2D as a presentation bridge.

completed_items.title: Existing refactor guide identifies the first coupling centers and recommended dependency direction.

pending_items.title: Decide the Attribute model / Unity adapter / UI view split.
Define the command-source interface before touching player, AI, network, or replay input.
Define presentation events before splitting UI, FX, audio, or animation calls out of combat behaviours.

tasks.title: Keep network architecture as evaluated but deferred
tasks.summary: Network and rollback remain important long-term goals, but the current project priority is to settle command-source, state, snapshot, and presentation boundaries before implementing multiplayer infrastructure.

completed_items.title: Existing network discussion records Cloudflare Tunnel, SignalR/WebSocket, UDP Relay, dedicated server, and rollback trade-offs.

pending_items.title: Do not begin network implementation until command-source and core state boundaries are stable.
When resumed, define transport/channel interfaces before choosing Unity Services, AWS, or local loopback infrastructure.
